transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

I’m here because for months now I’ve been noticing the same pattern. My sister’s appointments get moved, bills show up wrong, people “forget” to call me back… and everyone keeps saying it’s just mistakes, but it doesn’t feel like mistakes to me. I know they’re keeping information from me and trying to push me out of decisions.
Are you certain that people are deliberately trying to push you out, even when others tell you there isn’t proof?

Yes. I mean, I know people keep saying there’s no proof, but when the same things keep happening over and over—appointments moved, bills wrong, calls not returned—it doesn’t feel random. It feels like information is being kept from me so I won’t be included in decisions.
Is there any chance you might be mistaken about people deliberately keeping information from you?

I guess anything is possible, but no… I don’t really think I’m mistaken. This has been going on for months, and it’s the same kind of thing every time—appointments changed, bills wrong, people not calling me back. Everyone says it’s just mistakes, but to me it’s too consistent. It feels like they’re keeping me out on purpose.
Do you believe for certain that people are deliberately keeping information from you?

Yes. I do believe it. I know people keep calling them mistakes, but it’s been the same pattern for months—appointments moved, bills wrong, calls not returned. At some point it stops feeling accidental. It feels like they’re deliberately keeping information from me so I’m pushed out of decisions.
Have you been hearing voices when no one is there?
No, I don’t think so. I haven’t been hearing voices when no one is there.
Do you ever feel that someone can put thoughts into your mind or take thoughts out of it?
No, I don’t feel like that. My thoughts feel like my own. I don’t think anyone is putting thoughts in or taking them out.
Apart from this situation, have you generally found it hard to trust other people for most of your adult life?

I don’t know that I’d say that. I mean, I’ve had people I trusted over the years. I can be cautious, sure, but I haven’t thought of myself as someone who just can’t trust people in general. This feels more about what’s been happening lately.
Have you found yourself losing interest or motivation to do your usual activities?
I haven’t really noticed that, no. I still do my usual things for the most part. Maybe I get distracted sometimes, but I wouldn’t say I’ve lost interest or motivation.
Did all of this start very suddenly, over a few days?
No, not over just a few days. It’s been going on for about 11 months now, since my sister’s health suddenly got worse and I had to start coordinating her care.
Do you believe anything impossible or clearly unrealistic is happening to you, such as being controlled by outside forces?

Not controlled by outside forces, no. But I do think something is happening. For months I’ve seen the same pattern with my sister’s care—appointments getting moved, bills being wrong, people not calling me back—and everyone keeps saying it’s just mistakes. I don’t buy that. I think information is being kept from me, and they’re trying to push me out of the decisions.
Have other people told you that your speech or behavior has seemed disorganized or hard to follow?
No, I don’t think so. People may disagree with what I’m saying, but I haven’t been told I’m hard to follow or acting disorganized. I try to explain things pretty clearly.
Have you become much less emotionally expressive than usual—for example, people noticing your face or voice seems flat?
I haven’t really noticed that. I mean, I’ve been stressed, so maybe I sound tired sometimes, but no one has told me my face or voice seems flat or anything like that.
Have you seen things that other people could not see?
No, I haven’t seen things that other people couldn’t see. Not that I’m aware of.
Do you believe that anyone involved in this is using supernatural powers, advanced technology, or some impossible method to interfere with your sister’s care or keep information from you?

No, I don’t think it’s supernatural or anything impossible like that. It’s more that I keep seeing the same pattern with my sister’s care—appointments moved, bills being wrong, people saying they’ll call me back and then “forgetting.” Everyone keeps telling me it’s just mistakes, but I don’t believe that. I think information is being kept from me, and I’m being pushed out of decisions.
Do you ever find that your thoughts become so jumbled that it’s hard to speak in a clear, connected way?
I don’t think so. I mean, I get upset and sometimes I have to stop and collect myself, but my thoughts don’t feel jumbled to the point where I can’t explain what I mean.
Have you ever heard voices talking to each other about you?
No, I haven’t heard voices talking to each other about me. At least, nothing like that that I can recall.
Do you believe the people keeping information from you have abilities or methods that are impossible in real life?

No, I don’t think it’s some impossible method or anything like that. I think it’s people doing it—moving appointments, getting bills wrong, not calling me back when they say they will. They keep saying these are just mistakes, but after months of the same thing, I don’t believe that. It feels like they’re keeping information from me and trying to push me out of my sister’s decisions.
Do you believe, with certainty, that this is happening in a way that would be impossible in real life?

No, not impossible in real life. I mean, it’s not magic or anything. It’s just that for months now I keep seeing the same pattern—appointments moved, bills wrong, people saying they forgot to call me back. Everyone tells me it’s mistakes, but I know they’re keeping information from me and trying to push me out of my sister’s decisions.
Have you ever heard voices speaking directly to you when no one else was there?
No, I haven’t had that happen. I don’t hear voices speaking to me when I’m alone.
